title: The 'Add Asset' button is hidden in the New Work Order flow when Customers Create & Edit is OFF
custom_preconds: 1. A user has a role with Work orders Create & Edit ON, Customers View ON and Customers Create & Edit OFF.
custom_steps:
1. Log in and click New Work Order.
  2. Select an existing customer.
  3. Go to the asset/vehicle step.
  4. Look for an Add Asset button in the asset picker.
custom_expected:
The Add Asset button is not shown; the user can pick an existing asset but cannot create a new one.

(Known deviation: a prior run found this button still appearing when Customers Create & Edit is off — recommend a live re-check.)
evidence: UI (RUN331 FAIL PERSISTS): same role (Customers Create&Edit OFF). In the New Work Order modal, once a customer is selected, the "Add" (new asset) affordance next to the Asset field is SHOWN and ENABLED. (Before selecting a customer it is disabled only due to the customer-required dependency.) Expected: hidden when Customers Create&Edit is OFF. Gate not applied.
